# Draft:Forward Academic Team

}}
Forward Academic Team is a private educational institution based in Woolwich, London, United Kingdom. Incorporated under Company Number 08781355, it is officially registered with Companies House and operates as an accredited provider of dental nursing education. The institution specialises in dental nursing education and provides accredited training courses for students pursuing careers in the dental industry. It is recognised for its [https://www.nebdn.org/ NEBDN] accredited National Diploma in Dental Nursing and offers structured learning and placement support for students across the UK.
History
Forward Academic Team was established to address the growing demand for skilled dental nurses in the UK healthcare system. The institution has since expanded its offerings, catering to aspiring dental professionals by providing comprehensive training and career support.
Courses and Accreditation
Forward Academic Team offers the NEBDN-accredited National Diploma in Dental Nursing, a recognised qualification for individuals aiming to become General Dental Council (GDC) registered dental nurses.
Awards
In 2023, Forward Academic Team was honoured with the Special Recognition Award by the National Examining Board for Dental Nurses (NEBDN) for its significant group contribution to dental nurse education and development in the UK. This accolade underscores the institution's commitment to excellence in training dental professionals.
